items.document_title: Thermo Scientific CryoStar NX70 Operator Guide 387928 Issue 10
items.quote: The cooling phase will take approximately 2 to 3.5 hours depending on the set chamber temperature.
items.note: Operator Guide note after power-on: cooling phase 2 to 3.5 h depending on set chamber temperature; upper bound 3.5 h used as cooldown_time.max. Same guide applies to the HOMPDV catalog configuration.

ESPEC NA battery-chamber page gives only 'Temperature Fall Time | +20°C to -30°C within 60 min.' (snapshot line 187), i.e. to -30 C, not to the -40 C range limit/base; no pull-down time to -40 C is published. The ADBC flyer PDF is image-only (31 chars). Not reported as a value to avoid understating the cooldown to base.

Platinous J brochure and EPX-2J model page (c98e1451f190c129) give only average cooling rates (IEC 60068-3-5 at supply air; model page 'cooling -40 to 125°C (Empty)'), no pull-down time from ambient to -70 C. Deriving a time from a rate would be an estimate, so not reported.
EXT brochure and EXT2.0 model page (f56c92956c6d509c) state only change rates (70 C/min average, up to 100 C/min) for this LN2-cooled chamber; no documented pull-down time to -100 C.

items.document_title: ESPEC Thermal Shock Chamber TSD-101-W / TSE-12-A catalog (CAT.No.E16133-Z1609)
items.quote: Pull-down time *3 Within 90 min. from ambient temp. to −77℃  (Setting: −77℃)
items.note: Cold-chamber pull-down from ambient to the -77 C pre-cool lower limit (footnote *3: each chamber operated independently). Water-cooled TSD-101-W as in the configuration.

items.document_title: 7340/7380 Compact Temperature Calibration Baths (Fluke Calibration product page, specifications)
items.location: Specifications table, Cooling Time row, 7380 column
items.quote: Cooling Time | 110 minutes, from 25°C to –40°C (ethanol) | 130 minutes, from 25 °C to –80 °C (ethanol)
items.note: Table columns are 7340 | 7380; the 7380 value is 130 min from 25 C to -80 C (ethanol), i.e. to the bath minimum. The User's Guide PDF is blocked by robots.txt.

items.document_title: Technical Data Sheet, Model iBF125-GX (Helmer Scientific 380480/B 02/22)
items.note: Pull-down to the -35 C set point (the freezer's minimum), from 25 cu ft freezer data at 25 C ambient per the sheet footnote.

ID281 Pro brochure and product page (751665cb1e59939d) give base temperature <3 K and 24/7 runtime but no cooldown time. IDQ's ID281 CO launch page (364b217c0bf6dac0) only says 'Faster cooldown time' without a number.

Current ID281 brochure (June 2026) lists SO base <1 K and runtime >=24 h, no cooldown time. Lead only: a distributor page reproducing the legacy ID281 (0.8 K sorption, cryostat 53 x 30 x 30 cm) spec table states 'Cooldown time | 12 hours' (https://m.instrument.com.cn/netshow/SH104184/C389342.html, snapshot dff94805d5fe462b); the current SO cryostat is 63 x 45 x 30 cm, a different cryostat generation, so the figure is not assigned to this configuration.
Datasheet gives only transition rate (-55 to +125 C approx. 10 s) and range -80 to +225 C; no documented start-up/pull-down time from ambient to -80 C, and no manual with this figure was found.
